--- mapa/production_labels.py
+++ mapa/production_labels.py
@@ -31,7 +31,7 @@
     @app.get('/operations/production-labels')
     def production_labels():
         user=authenticated_user()
-        if not user:return jsonify(ok=False,error='Entre no Unificado para consultar as etiquetas.'),401
+        if not user:return jsonify(ok=False,error='Entre no Uni para consultar as etiquetas.'),401
         allowed,_=screen_access_state(user)
         readable=[s for s,screen in [('Setor 3','etiquetasSc'),('Setor 4','etiquetasSetor4')]
                   if screen in allowed or 'etiquetas' in allowed]

--- mapa/usina_iqt.py
+++ mapa/usina_iqt.py
@@ -65,7 +65,7 @@
     def usina_iqt():
         user = authenticated_user()
         if not user:
-            return jsonify(ok=False, error="Sessão expirada no Unificado."), 401
+            return jsonify(ok=False, error="Sessão expirada no Uni."), 401
         screens, _ = screen_access_state(user)
         if not ({"usinasInicio", "labUsinasRelatorios"} & set(screens)) or user.get("perfil") == "CONVIDADO":
             return jsonify(ok=False, error="Sem acesso a relatórios de Usinas."), 403
